title: Cartwise+ Membership Order Benefits and When They Apply
content:
A Cartwise+ Membership's order benefits are: free delivery on the services the plan lists when the order's item subtotal is at least the plan's free-delivery minimum; the plan's member service-fee rate; the plan's discount on the Express 30 fee; the small-basket fee waiver where the plan waives it; credit back; and Priority Delivery upgrades.

**When benefits apply.** Benefits apply to an order only when the membership is trialing or active on the order's placed date, or pending cancellation (the paid period has not yet ended), or past due where the plan's terms say benefits continue while past due; an applied, paused or canceled membership grants none. Benefits are judged once, on the placed date, and are not recomputed when the membership's status changes later. How each benefit enters the order's charges is set by the Cartwise Grocery Orders charter.

## Status on the order's placed date

| Membership status on the placed date | Benefits apply? |
|---|---|
| trialing | yes |
| active | yes |
| pending cancellation | yes |
| past due, on a plan whose benefits continue while past due | yes |
| past due, on a plan whose benefits do not continue while past due | no |
| applied | no |
| paused | no |
| canceled | no |

## Points of judgement

- **An order placed while active, and the membership is canceled before delivery.** The benefits were judged on the placed date, when the membership was active; they stay as judged.
- **An order placed while paused, and the membership resumes the next day.** The membership was paused on the placed date, so the order has no benefits; they are not recomputed.
- **Where the figures come from.** The free-delivery minimum, the listed services, the service-fee rate, the Express 30 discount and the small-basket waiver are per plan in the order benefits table.
